title: The golden's Berkshire dividend-rate sensitivity values are internally inconsistent and mathematically wrong, so a correct solution cannot match them.
evidence: Berk-Hath!G10:K14 golden: row F11 (7.5%) duplicates row F12 (8%) (G11=G12=11152.88); row F10 (7%) duplicates row F13 (8.5%) (11515.71); row F14 (9%) copies the term-table row G20:K20 (12241.37…). Base case I12 at 8%/7.3% = 10429.31, versus about 11470 implied by C44=11432.17 at 7.35%; PV is not monotonic in dividend rate.
